title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - RoadSegment
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/RoadSegment. Route taken by a waste collection vehicle between: (1) its depot and the first collection point on its round; (2) collection point n and collection point n+1 on its round; or (3) the last collection point on its round and a waste processing site. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.5).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RoadSegment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the road segment, expressed as a GeoJSON LineString.

sfContains.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfContains'. Spatially contains one or more of: a collection point, a depot, or a waste processing site (ontology restriction: at least one). Links to CollectionPoint, Depot, or WasteProcessingSite entities (open target type).

averageSpeedLimit.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/AverageSpeedLimit'. Mean speed limit for a road segment or an itinerary. Unit: km/h.
